desc:
🔫 HOOD STREET SHOWDOWN: RED vs BLUE 🔫
Fast first-person gunfights on the block. Pick your side, grab your guns and run the streets.

⚡ Smooth movement: sprint, slide, bunny hop, mantle
💥 16 guns: switch Glocks, pumps, snipers with collaterals
💵 Earn cash every match and buy guns from THE PLUG
👕 Customize your look: face, hair, skin
📲 Full mobile and controller support 


🏙️ HOOD MAPS: Two-Flat Court, Container Yard, Corner Crash
🎯 MODES: Team Showdown, Block Party, Badge Rush, Free-For-All
📱 CALL KILLSTREAKS ON YOUR PHONE:
• SNITCH: see every enemy on the map
• OPPS: send in the muscle
• DRIVE BY: your crew rolls through with the music loud
• COP RAID: sirens on the whole map as the cops pull up


Stay in the lobby or jump straight into the next match. Squad up with friends!

👍 Like + ⭐ Favorite for updates!
